tests.name: WorkflowCatalog_WhenLoaded_ValidatesImmutableModulePaths
tests.description: The versioned catalog yields one immutable snapshot, supports a path override, accepts an empty catalog, and rejects malformed, duplicate, or blank module paths.
tests.arrange: Temporary valid and invalid workflow_catalog.json files
tests.act: Load each file through the catalog loader
tests.assert: Valid module paths are returned as a tuple and categorized validation errors occur before imports

tests.name: WorkflowModules_WhenLoaded_ValidateEverySpecBeforeRuntime
tests.description: Configured modules are imported and their SPEC values and globally unique module names are validated before runtime resources are opened.
tests.arrange: Importable fake modules covering valid, missing, wrong-type, duplicate-name, and failed-import entries
tests.act: Load all configured module entry points
tests.assert: Only WorkflowModuleSpec entries are returned and invalid catalogs raise a clear startup error

tests.name: WorkerTopology_WhenComposed_GroupsRoutesAndRejectsConflicts
tests.description: Modules are deterministically grouped by exact domain and task list into one WorkerSpec per route while route-local wire-name conflicts are rejected.
tests.arrange: WorkflowModuleSpec values on shared and independent routes with both disjoint and overlapping names
tests.assert: Shared routes produce one sorted WorkerSpec and duplicate workflow or Activity names fail composition

tests.name: WorkerRegistry_WhenBuilt_RegistersDeclaredModuleSurface
tests.description: A fresh Cadence Registry is built per WorkerSpec and registration failures or declaration mismatches are rejected.
tests.arrange: Worker specs with accurate, throwing, under-registering, and over-registering module callbacks
tests.assert: The registry exactly matches declared workflow and Activity wire names before polling starts

priority_groups.description: Priority 2: Diagnostic routing and runtime lifecycle

tests.name: DiagnosticWorkflow_WhenRegistered_IsRouteScoped
tests.description: Each Worker registry contains a generic SingleActivityWorkflow limited to that route's declared Activity names.
tests.arrange: Two worker routes with distinct declared Activity names
tests.act: Build both registries and execute their diagnostic workflow validation paths
tests.assert: Each registry registers the diagnostic wire type and rejects Activity names from the other route

tests.name: WorkerRuntime_WhenStarted_ManagesTopologyTransactionally
tests.description: One Client and Worker context is supervised per WorkerSpec with all-or-nothing startup and reverse-order cleanup.
tests.arrange: Fake async Client and Worker factories for successful startup, second-worker startup failure, and stop signaling
tests.assert: Readiness follows complete startup, failures surface, and every entered context closes in reverse order

tests.name: OrchestratorCli_WhenInspectingCatalog_ReportsMachineReadableTopology
tests.description: The composition root exposes inspect-catalog output and treats an empty valid catalog as a warned successful no-op without opening Cadence resources.
tests.arrange: Valid populated and empty catalog snapshots with injectable output, logger, and runtime
tests.act: Invoke inspect-catalog and worker startup entry points
tests.assert: JSON contains sorted domains and routes, and empty startup returns successfully with zero workers

tests.name: OrchestratorPackage_WhenImportsAnalyzed_ContainsOnlyGenericConcerns
tests.description: The orchestrator package depends only on common, Cadence, standard library, and dynamically configured entry points and contains no Story Analysis domain concepts.
tests.act: Analyze imports and source text statically
tests.assert: No workflow package imports, skill names, grading rules, artifact conventions, Activity implementations, or domain result details remain
